purpose: Teach: 東大/明治維新/封建/前例/欠落/気の毒/暴走/衝動

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、東大、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on Tokyo University's approach to history — I was genuinely impressed by how thoroughly you handled it.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Lean slightly forward. Steady eye contact. Pause slightly before the compliment lands — genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本気で、絶対、明治維新、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. The Meiji Restoration is such dense material, and I really tried to research it deeply. I appreciate your guidance.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude, slightly formal. Straightforward delivery — earnest without overselling. Slight hesitation before committing to the thanks, checking himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 江戸時代の、本気で、絶対、封建、絶対、制、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you covered the feudal systems of the Edo period — your perspective was really broad. Genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slower pace. Nod slightly. Let the approval settle in the room. This is genuine observation, not flattery — each word lands with weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、前例、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to make sure I understood the historical precedents deeply. I'm grateful for how much you pushed me on the research.
lines.style: Earnest and direct. No performance. Simple gratitude in a calm, steady register. The tone of someone genuinely meaning what he says.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 記録の、本気で、絶対、欠落、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The gaps in the historical record you addressed — that took real insight. I was impressed by that choice.
lines.style: Engaged and specific. Slight emphasis on 'gaps' and 'choice' — she's noticing something uncommon in student work. Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦争被害者への、本気で、絶対、気の毒、絶対、な、絶対、立場、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to be really careful about how I handled the perspectives of war victims — the suffering was real, and I wanted to honor that in my research.
lines.style: Quiet seriousness. Slower, more deliberate pacing. This is where the surface earnestness becomes something deeper — he cares about the ethical weight of what he's done.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、暴走、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you tackled the issue of wartime escalation and how impulses became policy — that's sophisticated analysis. Genuinely good work.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative tone. Nod slowly. This is genuine intellectual approval — she's seeing something mature in his thinking. Warm but not effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の、本気で、絶対、衝動、絶対、的決断、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to understand not just what happened, but how reasonable people made impulsive choices in crisis. That was the hardest part to research honestly.
lines.style: Quiet, final. Almost as if he's speaking to himself as much as to her. Honest about the difficulty. No need to oversell — the sincerity carries itself.
